name: pie_status
purpose: Truthful PIE state across full lifecycle (queued/starting/running/simulating/travelling/stopping/stopped) and all instances via context enumeration.
cooked: works — PIE over cooked/pak-mounted maps is exactly the DDS2 flow; state derivation touches no asset data
prevents: Agent aborts a live session because one poll said stopped — GEditor->PlayWorld null/stale during travel, client connect, multi-instance, throttling (Holes A-E)
hazards: GEditor->PlayWorld is a per-tick scratch pointer, never a liveness authority — must never be read
Out-of-process (Standalone Game) sessions are unobservable in-process by engine design (PlayLevelNewProcess.cpp:57-59) — document, don't fix
bIsSimulatingInEditor member is deprecated-in-practice — use IsSimulatingInEditor() accessor
If PIE contexts exist without session info, report state:"unknown" — never fabricate stopped while a PIE world exists

name: snap_actors_to_ground
purpose: Penetrating ECR_Overlap multi-trace so landscape is reachable through blocking geometry; per-actor diagnosis echo makes every miss self-explaining.
cooked: works — heightfield and static-mesh collision of pak-mounted content is live in the editor world; no asset data read
prevents: 112/303 unexplained misses on flat ground — first-blocking-hit truncation (World.h:1956) hides landscape behind roads/props/floors
hazards: Overlap-mode hits have bBlockingHit=false — the ground scan must not filter on it
maxHits cap can fill without a ground match — report reason:"hit list truncated", never a silent miss
LineTraceMultiByChannel cannot see past the first blocking hit under default responses — anti-pattern anywhere else in the bridge
ULandscapeHeightfieldCollisionComponent::GetHeight is not linkable (MinimalAPI) — use LANDSCAPE_API GetHeightAtLocation instead
